name: resend_send_email
description: Send a transactional email via Resend with HTML or plain text, cc/bcc, reply-to, attachments, and optional scheduling.

to.description: Recipient email or array of emails

name: resend_get_email
description: Get the details and status of a sent Resend email by its ID.

name: resend_update_email
description: Update a scheduled email — typically used to reschedule its delivery time.

name: resend_cancel_scheduled_email
description: Cancel a scheduled email before it is sent.

name: resend_send_batch_emails
description: Send multiple emails in a single API call (batch sending). Pass an array of email objects.

emails.description: Array of email objects (same fields as resend_send_email)

name: resend_list_domains
description: List all sending domains configured in the Resend account.

name: resend_get_domain
description: Get details for a specific sending domain including verification status.

name: resend_create_domain
description: Add a new sending domain to Resend for verified email delivery.

name: resend_verify_domain
description: Trigger domain verification check after DNS records have been set.

name: resend_update_domain
description: Update a domain's tracking settings (open tracking, click tracking, TLS).

name: resend_delete_domain
description: Remove a sending domain from Resend.

name: resend_get_domain_records
description: Get the DNS records (SPF, DKIM, MX) needed to verify a domain in Resend.

name: resend_list_api_keys
description: List all API keys in the Resend account.

name: resend_create_api_key
description: Create a new Resend API key with full_access or sending_access permissions.

domain_id.description: Restrict key to a specific domain

name: resend_delete_api_key
description: Delete a Resend API key.

name: resend_list_audiences
description: List all contact audiences in the Resend account.

name: resend_get_audience
description: Get details for a specific Resend audience.

name: resend_create_audience
description: Create a new contact audience for email marketing campaigns.

name: resend_delete_audience
description: Delete an audience and all its contacts.

name: resend_find_audience_by_name
description: Find a Resend audience by its name (case-insensitive search).

name: resend_list_contacts
description: List all contacts in a Resend audience.

name: resend_get_contact
description: Get a specific contact in a Resend audience by contact ID.

name: resend_create_contact
description: Add a contact to a Resend audience.

name: resend_update_contact
description: Update a contact's name or subscription status in a Resend audience.

name: resend_delete_contact
description: Remove a contact from a Resend audience.

name: resend_unsubscribe_contact
description: Mark a contact as unsubscribed in a Resend audience.

name: resend_resubscribe_contact
description: Re-subscribe a previously unsubscribed contact in a Resend audience.

name: resend_bulk_create_contacts
description: Add multiple contacts to a Resend audience in one call. Returns a count of created vs failed.

name: resend_list_broadcasts
description: List all broadcast email campaigns in the Resend account.

name: resend_get_broadcast
description: Get details for a specific Resend broadcast campaign.

name: resend_create_broadcast
description: Create a new email broadcast campaign targeted to a Resend audience.

name: resend_update_broadcast
description: Update a draft broadcast campaign's subject, content, or sender.

name: resend_send_broadcast
description: Send or schedule a broadcast campaign to its target audience.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp to schedule (omit to send immediately)

name: resend_delete_broadcast
description: Delete a broadcast campaign.

name: resend_list_webhooks
description: List all webhook endpoints configured in the Resend account.

name: resend_get_webhook
description: Get details for a specific Resend webhook.

name: resend_create_webhook
description: Create a webhook to receive Resend events (email.sent, email.delivered, email.bounced, etc.).

name: resend_delete_webhook
description: Delete a Resend webhook endpoint.

name: resend_get_account
description: Get the current Resend account details.

name: resend_send_template_email
description: SUPER TOOL: Send an email using a Handlebars-style template with {{variable}} substitution — no need to build HTML in your app code.

variables.description: Key-value pairs to substitute into the template

name: resend_add_subscriber
description: SUPER TOOL: Find or create an audience by name and add a contact to it — subscriber onboarding in one call without needing to manage audience IDs.

audience_name.description: Audience name — created if it doesn't exist

name: resend_send_welcome_email
description: SUPER TOOL: Send a responsive branded welcome email with pre-built HTML — just provide app name, user name, and optional CTA.

name: resend_send_password_reset_email
description: SUPER TOOL: Send a responsive password reset email with pre-built HTML — provide the reset URL and it handles the rest.

name: resend_send_invoice_email
description: SUPER TOOL: Send a clean invoice/receipt email with itemized list and total using pre-built HTML.

name: resend_create_and_send_broadcast
description: SUPER TOOL: Create a broadcast campaign and send it to an audience in one call.

name: resend_account_summary
description: SUPER TOOL: Get a full account overview — verified domains, audience counts, API key count — in one call.
